title: Fix 329 check first
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cli-012 already says chough bug add while a session is active SHALL add the new bug to that session's checkpoint; a bug written but left out of a full session broke that, so bug add now checks that the session can take the link before writing anything and refuses otherwise, with only code, test and doc changes.
acceptance_criteria: With a session active that already holds its 200 bug links, chough bug add refuses before writing anything, naming the session and the limit, and no new .chough/bugs record exists afterwards; the session record is byte-identical. With room left, bug add writes the bug and links it as before.

answers.constraints: Leif's P2 review comment on #343 and the standing rule 'Yes, for today' set the scope, with t4c's design point: check that the active session can take another bug link before writing anything and refuse with nothing written, as in #312, #340 and #332, rather than removing a file afterwards (#306). Deltas none; REQ-cli-012 already requires the link. A boundary regression test, red first.
